summary: xAI released Grok Imagine Video 1.5, an updated image-to-video model with improved audio, motion and speed, now generally available via the Imagine API and Grok apps, alongside new creative workflow features.

practices.reason: The model states concrete gains in synchronized audio/speech generation, more stable motion/physics, and near-doubled generation speed, all of which change what a creative video product could ship.
practices.quote: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Fast almost doubles generation speed: it produces 6-second, 720p videos in about 25 seconds, down from 40+ seconds in our previous model.

practices.reason: The model moves out of preview to general availability under a new API model identifier, requiring teams to update integration code and pin the new model name.
practices.quote: Imagine Video 1.5 is out of preview and generally available in the xAI API as grok-imagine-video-1.5 .
